title: The Bus Route Change · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少80词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message (about 80 words) to a friend about a change to your bus or train route. Say what changed, how you feel, and what you will do.
Write at least 80 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
